n1.text: Distribute. Page header shows the three steps (add files, map destinations, review and send) and ticks them off. Left: Add files (bad files are refused at once) and a live summary: files, destinations, deliveries and total size uploaded once.

n2.text: Documents. Each row shows its type, where it is going (folder chips), and its state: uploading, Checking for malware, Verified, or Refused (by storage, which can be retried, or for malware, which must be removed). The eye button previews a file from the copy in the browser, before anything is sent. Send turns on only when every file is verified.

n3.text: Destinations. A banner says which files a tick applies to. Filter, expand binders, tick folders: a tick means every file in scope, a dash means some. Review, a full-width section under the three panels, shows every chosen folder with the names, types and sizes of the files going to it, each with Preview and a cross to remove it from that folder (a cross on the folder removes the whole folder). The bottom bar shows readiness checks and a Send button that sends at once.

n4.text: Status: your distributions, or My teams (other people's distributions with deliveries to your teams; counts refresh every 30 seconds), or open one by pasting its full id or link (with nothing open, the page asks you to pick one). The sender sees every delivery; anyone else sees only the deliveries to their own teams, and can download only those files. Detail shows totals, a progress bar, Cancel distribution while deliveries are still waiting (running ones finish; waiting ones show Cancelled in grey, counted apart from failures), Retry failed deliveries for the sender (24 hours after the first finish, not for a cancelled job), and two tabs: Deliveries (status, attempts of 5, reason codes, Preview and Download for each delivered file (both through a 2-minute link, and a preview opens in an in-page viewer), expired files) and Audit. Audit trail: the full history you are allowed to see, grouped by day. Nothing is ever deleted.

n5.text: Demo controls (bottom left) and System activity (top right). Switch who is signed in: Raj (Cardio only) opens JOB-2040 but sees only its Cardio deliveries; Sam (Neuro) gets not found. Import a sample mapping (one file is caught by the malware scan), remove Priya from Oncology mid-distribution, drop the live connection, skip to a minute before the token runs out to watch the quiet refresh, or to the end of the 12-hour sign-in to see the sign-in dialog. On the sign-in page, five wrong passwords pause sign-in for 15 minutes with the same message. System activity explains what the system does behind each click.
